problem.title: Snakes and Ladders
problem.problemStatement: You are given an n × n Snakes and Ladders board. Starting from square 1, each move consists of rolling a six-sided die and moving accordingly. If the destination square contains the start of a ladder or the head of a snake, immediately move to its destination. Return the minimum number of moves required to reach the final square. Return -1 if it is impossible.
problem.input: Integer n An n × n board.
problem.output: A single integer representing the minimum number of moves.
